our_interpretation: This concerns the existence and content of a projection, not whether the projected profit subsequently materialized.
The referenced reporting identifies the June 2026 quarter and operating profit excluding stock-based compensation. Profit is assessed on that reported basis, not as net income.
Slightly profitable means a small positive margin relative to quarterly revenue; Marcus supplies no numerical margin threshold.
The observation period is May 20–21, 2026, when the report appeared and Marcus described the projection as current.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable reporting establishes that Anthropic projected its first quarterly operating profit, with the projected profit small relative to quarterly revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The referenced reporting instead describes a projected loss, an earlier operating-profitable quarter, or a materially different projection.
